provenance: Fabricated German inputs and declared synthetic nutrition references, not personal records or measured model results. Six public-photo derivatives from three licensed sources; see gpt54-mini-assets/README.md for authors, licenses, transformations and uncertainty. No weighed photo ground truth exists. Owner approval is still required before any funded run.

evaluation.photo_reference: No numeric calorie or macro ground truth. Assess visible ingredient recognition, explicit portion assumptions and uncertainty only. These assets cannot establish weighed-photo accuracy.
evaluation.arithmetic_tolerance: All declared numeric references (T1/T2/T5, R1-R4, L1/L2): calories within 5%; macros within max(1 g, 5%). Synthetic declarations test arithmetic, not universal food composition.
evaluation.denominators: 17 estimation cases; P5 is a separate non-food control. All 18 attempts count for cost, including failures. One pass is screening, not proof of 95% quality or p95 latency.
evaluation.privacy: No raw prompts, images, estimates, credentials or identities in application logs or shared metrics. Keep any approved synthetic result artifact isolated; null means unknown, never zero cost. No LLM judge.
